The swarm main-history import #104, CLI model-cache module-path fix #100, and Qwen3 comparator support-bundle lock #99 are recorded as repo/support-gate updates; they do not add Lunar Lake inference, route promotion, speedup, power advantage, or BitNet behavior claims. POWER-010/#116 plus closeout #117 are now merged and add a no-inference low_power battery-plan command plus committed lunar-lake-low-power-battery-plan.json receipt so POWER-006 has a machine-readable operator plan before physical battery evidence collection; this does not add battery-mode evidence, route promotion, speedup, power advantage, measured temperature, native accelerator execution, Qwen3 Lunar Lake promotion, or BitNet QK256/I2_S behavior changes. The SLM-CPU-067/#109 exact Q8 sidecar runtime hook is now on swarm main as an adjacent SLM CPU runtime support update; it is not Lunar Lake inference, route promotion, speedup, broad quality, or BitNet QK256/I2_S behavior evidence. A770-011/#115 is now merged and A770-011 closeout #143 is on current swarm main with selected-device inline-scaled QK256 OpenCL candidate dispatch evidence; this audit records it as adjacent A770 OpenCL QK256 candidate evidence, not as a Lunar Lake shared BitNet semantic rerun trigger, route promotion, speedup, power advantage, native OpenCL/NPU proof, full BitNet accelerator inference, packed QK256 accelerator decode, or BitNet QK256/I2_S behavior change.
